metadata.task: BTC ETF Flow Signal Line Formal Closure
metadata.closure_reason: Two sequential attempts (K455 + K462) both REJECT on core gates; line archived

closure_rationale.original_line: BTC ETF Flow Signal Alpha Line
closure_rationale.first_attempt: K455 BTC Total ETF Flow (Farside Investors)

k455_evidence.key_failure: G5_corr_K280_est: 0.42 (threshold 0.40). ETF EMA-21 is 75% correlated with BTC 21d momentum direction, signal is not orthogonal.
k455_evidence.interpretation: Detrending removes edge entirely. Strategy is trend-following, not pure ETF flow alpha. Institutional amplification of BTC momentum, not independent signal.

k462_evidence.direction_failure: Raw divergence correlation with BTC forward returns = -0.116 (negative). GBTC-IBIT rotation hypothesis is DIRECTIONALLY INVERTED.
k462_evidence.peak_divergence_hypothesis: High IBIT>GBTC divergence peaks at BTC price tops (FOMO into IBIT, profit-taking in GBTC) — contrarian signal, not bullish. Detrended signal catastrophically negative.

summary.k455_finding: Marginal OOS pass (Sharpe 1.041 vs threshold 1.0) on 4/8 gates. 75% momentum correlation fails orthogonality. Detrended signal SR = -0.54 confirms trend-capture, not alpha.
summary.k462_finding: Complete REJECT: 0/7 gates. Directionally inverted (-0.117 corr with forward returns). Detrended signal SR = -2.026 (worse than K455). No path to improvement without new data source.
summary.cumulative_evidence: ETF flow (raw or divergence-based) does not provide independent alpha from BTC momentum. Both signal forms fail OOS validation under orthogonality constraint.

reopen_conditions.trigger_a_condition: Access to intraday (hourly+) per-fund ETF flows (vs current daily aggregate)
reopen_conditions.trigger_a_data_source: Farside Investors API or Bloomberg (requires paid subscription)
reopen_conditions.trigger_a_action: Test correlation decay between IBIT/GBTC/other-funds and 1h/4h BTC momentum
reopen_conditions.trigger_b_condition: Historical flows from Hong Kong Spot ETF, Brazil ETFs, or other non-US venues
reopen_conditions.trigger_b_data_source: DefiLlama bridge flows, Coingecko, or regional exchange APIs
reopen_conditions.trigger_b_action: Test divergence between US-traded GBTC/IBIT and non-US flows for rotation signals
reopen_conditions.trigger_c_condition: New institutional investor cohort (e.g., pension funds, insurance) with different flow timing vs passive index rebalances
reopen_conditions.trigger_c_monitoring: Governance or regulatory change enabling new fund category
reopen_conditions.trigger_c_action: Reassess signal sensitivity to buyer mix

entry_btc_etf.rationale: K455: 4/8 gates (75% momentum corr, detrended SR -0.54). K462: 0/7 gates (directionally inverted -0.117, detrended SR -2.026). ETF flow does not provide orthogonal alpha.
reopen_triggers: Intraday per-fund ETF flow data (hourly+) with reduced correlation decay
Non-US BTC ETF flows (Hong Kong, Brazil) with demonstrated divergence timing
Structural regime change (new institutional cohort with different rebalance timing)
